info.name: Atlassian Admin Account Commit Statuses API
Atlassian List Commit Statuses For A Commit

params.name: repo_slug
params.description:
This can either be the repository slug or the UUID of the repository,
surrounded by curly-braces, for example: `{repository UUID}`.

params.name: workspace
params.description:
This can either be the workspace ID (slug) or the workspace UUID
surrounded by curly-braces, for example: `{workspace UUID}`.

params.name: q
params.description:
Query string to narrow down the response as per
[filtering and sorting](/cloud/bitbucket/rest/intro/#filtering).

params.name: sort
params.description:
Field by which the results should be sorted as per
[filtering and sorting](/cloud/bitbucket/rest/intro/#filtering).
Defaults to `created_on`.

items.docs: Returns all statuses (e.g. build results) for a specific commit.

be overwritten.

info.name: Atlassian Update A Build Status For A Commit

params.name: repo_slug
params.description:
This can either be the repository slug or the UUID of the repository,
surrounded by curly-braces, for example: `{repository UUID}`.

params.name: workspace
params.description:
This can either be the workspace ID (slug) or the workspace UUID
surrounded by curly-braces, for example: `{workspace UUID}`.

items.docs:
Used to update the current status of a build status object on the
specific commit.

This operation can also be used to change other properties of the
build status:

* `state`
* `name`
* `description`
* `url`
* `refname`

The `key` cannot be changed.
